# R2.14 — Telemetry emitters + the live exporter seam

Ticket `docs/tickets/120_R2.14__telemetry-exporter-seam.md`
(seq 120). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.13` (PR #120);
ADR-0346. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — the only
wire is the egress mediator's loopback fixture transport; no live
backend, no staging, no production mutation.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.14-1 · DF-S1.14-2 · DF-S1.14-4 · BL-24 ·
R-2.9.1.

## What landed

**Residual emitter classes (DF-S1.14-1a; ADR-0346 D1).** M5/M6/M13–M15
now mint durable rows from their real producing paths with
member-stamped durations — `context.assembled{assembly_ms}`,
`context.compaction.started/completed{at_ms,
duration_ms{value,measured_at}}`, `action.environment.*` carrying
`env_ms`/`snapshot_ms{value,measured_at}` + `at_ms`,
`context.memory.*`/`control.wakeup.*` carrying `at_ms`/`sleep_ms`,
and `at_ms`/`started_at_ms`/`turn_e2e_ms`/`wall_ms` on the turn and
effect boundaries. `measured_value` resolves both the bare-integer and
`{value,measured_at}` spellings; `DurationSource::TimingMember` reads
`timing.<f>` members; the `EnvironmentOp`/`Wakeup` scope coordinates
resolve `env_handle`/`subscription_id` — pre-R2.14 rows fold
unchanged (CC8).

**`turn_phase_profile` (DF-S1.14-1b; ADR-0346 D5).**
`ViewKind::TurnPhaseProfile` + `phase.rs` — a pure fold partitioning a
turn's wall into §5h.1 §2.2's seven members under the innermost-owns
claim order (permission waits innermost, then sampling, tool-blocking,
compaction). Unstamped boundaries count as `unbounded_intervals`,
never fabricated; `clock_skew_flag` fires past `clock_tolerance_ms`;
missing boundary stamps render every `*_ms` cell
`n/a{observability}` while request/retry counts stay honest.

**MCP/ACP propagation carriers (DF-S1.14-1c; ADR-0346 D2).** The
`hh` tracestate member (`run:<id>;ev:<id>`) + optional
`hh.configuration_id` baggage ride MCP `_meta`
(`call_tool_carried`/`call_tool_propagated`,
`McpExecutor::set_propagation` — existing `name`/`arguments`/
`requestState`/`target` members preserved) and ACP `_meta.hh`
(`SessionUpdate::to_notification_propagated` — `source_seq`,
`agent_semantic_id`, `hh_methods`, `update_kinds` preserved).
`inbound_context`/`meta_carrier`/`acp_hh_members`/`carrier_loss`
parse strictly: malformed or absent members answer
`InvalidInboundContext`/named loss — a foreign context is never
grafted onto a ledger event it does not name.

**Convention sinks + lift-back (DF-S1.14-2a; ADR-0346 D3).**
`genai::lower_run_refs` stamps `hh.run_id`/`hh.event_id` liftable
coordinates; `openinfer.rs` is the second convention shape
(`openinference.span.kind=LLM`, `llm.token_count.*`). Both emit named
`LossEntry` reports for unrepresentable members; `lift::lift_span`
resolves `Some(EventRef)` only when both coordinates are present —
a foreign span lifts `None`.

**Hosted `n/a` + per-config distributions (DF-S1.14-2b/c; ADR-0346
D6).** `metric_view_scoped` applies the catalogue `applies_to` gate
per participant class — native-only metrics render typed
`n/a{class}` for hosted rows, never zeros; the pre-existing
`metric_view` delegates native-scoped, byte-identical. Catalogue
distributions fold per `configuration_id`
(`n`/`min`/`p50`/`p95`/`max` per configuration's own prefix).

**The exporter-as-subscriber seam (DF-S1.14-4; ADR-0346 D4).**
`hh-embed::subscriber::ExportSubscriber` tails `read(watermark+1)`
over the durable prefix, lowers the delta under the declared
`SinkPolicy` (consent/rate/content gates pre-wire), hands one
`net_egress` POST to the caller's `EgressMediator` — the only wire;
attribution and `security.egress.*` rows are the mediator's durable
record — and appends `measurement.export.delivered` through
`commit_kernel_row_for` on the run's persisted writer-lease
generation only on `Forwarded`. Refused/asked/credential-refused
outcomes append nothing: an unlisted sink is an egress fact, not a
telemetry event. `participant_reported` hosted ingestion landed at
S4.15 (`hh-hosting` M18 legs); `delivered`/`activated`/`followed`
landed earlier and are exercised durable (`hh-control` driver mints).

**DF/BL dispositions.** DF-S1.14-1 → DONE (emitters + phase profile +
carriers; `audit_view` landed S1.15). DF-S1.14-2 → DONE (both sink
fixtures + lift-back, hosted `n/a` sweep, per-config distributions).
DF-S1.14-4 → DONE (subscriber + egress-mediated delivery +
`measurement.export.delivered`; `participant_reported` and the
lifecycle classes verified landed). BL-24 → closed. None opened.

## Tests (fail-if-removed)

- `crates/hh-telemetry/tests/r2_14.rs` — 11 cells: carrier-loss
  spelling; MCP `_meta` round-trip through `inbound_carrier`;
  malformed/absent inbound refusal; ACP `_meta.hh` flat members;
  GenAI liftable carrier stamping; OpenInference lowering +
  lift-back; per-configuration distributions; hosted `n/a{class}`;
  nested measured durations + scope coordinates; unbounded
  `turn_phase_profile` typed `n/a`; wall-time partitioning.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r2_14.rs` — 2 cells: unlisted sink is an
  egress refusal with **no** `measurement.export.delivered` row;
  the subscriber tails `read`, delivers through the egress-mediated
  loopback fixture, and appends the delivered row durably.
- Regression: `hh-mcp` client tests (24 — incl.
  `call_tool_propagated_rides_the_meta_slot`), hh-control/hh-env
  emitter batteries unchanged and green, `hh-hosting` M18 legs,
  `hh-embed` r2_5/`hh-control` r2_5+s3_10 `delivered`/`activated`/
  `followed` cells.
